queries: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items) SELECT o.order_id, o.average_quantity, o.average_quantity - b.average_quantity AS difference_from_baseline FROM order_averages AS o CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.average_quantity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.average_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference_from_baseline DESC LIMIT 10

WITH order_averages AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items) SELECT oa.order_id, oa.average_quantity, oa.average_quantity - b.average_quantity AS difference_from_baseline FROM order_averages AS oa CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.average_quantity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (oa.average_quantity - b.average_quantity) IS NULL ASC, difference_from_baseline DESC LIMIT 10

WITH item_quantities AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS DECIMAL(19,4)) AS quantity FROM Order_Items), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(quantity) AS baseline_quantity FROM item_quantities), order_averages AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(quantity) AS average_quantity FROM item_quantities GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.order_id, o.average_quantity, o.average_quantity - b.baseline_quantity AS difference_from_baseline FROM order_averages o CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE b.baseline_quantity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (o.average_quantity - b.baseline_quantity) IS NULL, difference_from_baseline DESC LIMIT 10;
